key: put place object receptacle holding destination
when: The agent is holding the requested object, is at the requested destination, and observations confirm all required object transformations are complete.
do: Use the admissible placement action to put the held object in or on the requested receptacle.

key: find search object closed cabinet drawer fridge container
when: The agent is searching for an object and the current observation shows a relevant closed container that has not been inspected.
do: Open that container using an admissible action, then inspect its visible contents.
